zh.documents.archived: 已建立 Mnemon 冷索引并归档；关联记忆空间：{spaces}
zh.documents.archivedLocally: 已归档到本地：原文移入归档目录，没有建立 Mnemon 冷索引。
zh.documents.emptyActiveText: 复杂对话达到活动评分门槛后会自动审阅并整理档案，也可以在上方手动创建。
zh.documents.emptyArchivedText: 只有完成 Mnemon 索引的档案才会迁移到这里。

zh.documents.deleteDescription: 将永久移除档案记录和托管副本，无法撤销。不会建立记忆空间冷索引，也不会修改已有记忆空间条目或项目源文件。
zh.documents.archiveDescription: 将托管资料移到本地归档，之后仍可在归档列表查阅。
zh.documents.footnote: `.mnemon/documents/index.json` 是控制面事实源；active 总量固定不超过 10 MB，archived 不计入上限，项目源文件不会被修改。

en.documents.title: Workspace Documents

en.documents.editorHint: Save Markdown content or provide only paths to sources in this workspace.
en.documents.name: Title
en.documents.createdAfterArchive: Archived {count} older document(s), then created the active document.
en.documents.updatedAfterArchive: Archived {count} older document(s), then saved the revision.
en.documents.archived: Mnemon cold index created and document archived; Memory Spaces: {spaces}
en.documents.archivedLocally: Archived locally: the original moved to the archive, without a Mnemon cold index.
en.documents.emptyActiveText: Complex work is reviewed after it reaches the activity-score gate, or you can create a Document above.
en.documents.emptyArchivedText: Only documents with a completed Mnemon index are moved here.
en.documents.selectText: Read active project knowledge or follow a Mnemon reference to an archived original.
en.documents.deleteDescription: This permanently removes the document record and managed copy and cannot be undone. No Memory Space index is created. Existing Memory Space entries and original project files remain unchanged.
en.documents.archiveDescription: Move this managed material to the local archive, where it remains available to read.
en.documents.footnote: `.mnemon/documents/index.json` is the control-plane source of truth. active stays at or below 10 MB, archived is excluded, and project source files are never modified.
